description: This file defines an Android UI dialog for adding a leave entry, including date picking and leave type selection, and saving the leave data via a repository.

classes.name: AddLeaveDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass that enables users to input leave details, select date and type, and save the leave.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the custom dialog view, including setting up date picker and leave type dropdown.

methods.name: setupDatePicker
methods.description: Initializes date input field with current date and sets up a click listener to show a DatePicker dialog.

methods.name: setupTypeDropdown
methods.description: Populates the leave type dropdown with available leave types.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Constructs a Leave object from user input and saves it asynchronously through the repository.
